starting-off.speaker: Morgan
starting-off.text: Could it be? A bold adventurer! Please, you must help us!

starting-off.player: What is it? What's the problem?

starting-off.speaker: Morgan
starting-off.text: It's the evil vampyre, Count Draynor! For too long he's terrorised us from his manor to the north. Someone finally needs to put a stop to him once and for all!
If the player has a combat level less than 20:

options.text: Yes.

steps.player: Sounds like a job for me. Where should I start?

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: Oh, thank goodness! I've been hoping this day would come for a long time, so I've made sure to do my research. I've heard of a retired vampyre hunter called Dr Harlow who lives in Varrock.

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: If you speak to him, I'm sure he'll be able to help. I hear he's a bit of an old soak these days, so he spends most of his time in the Blue Moon Inn.

options.text: What else can you tell me about this vampyre?

steps.player: What else can you tell me about this vampyre?

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: All sorts of things! I've studied the legends extensively!

steps.player: Wait... legends? What do you mean legends?

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: The legends of Count Draynor! It's said that long ago, he travelled here from dark lands in the east. He built Draynor Manor, and from there he began his campaign of darkness against our peaceful lands!

steps.player: Long ago? If this has been going on for so long, why has no one tried to stop him?

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: Many have tried. All have failed. Vampyres are not killed easily. Only those with the right skills and equipment have any hope of slaying one.

steps.player: Like this Dr Harlow? Home come he's never tried to kill this Count Draynor?

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: I'm... not sure. Perhaps he was always too busy killing other vampyres?

steps.player: Hmm... Something seems amiss here. Are you sure you're telling me everything?

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: Well... it is true that some claim Count Draynor hasn't left his manor for generations now.

steps.player: So he's not actually attacked the village?

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: Er... no. At least, not for a long time! He used to though!

steps.player: When?

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: Well... not since I've moved here at least.

steps.player: So if there's no actual danger, why are you so keen for someone to kill this vampyre?

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: Because what if he does start attacking again? Are we just meant to live our lives constantly fearing the future?

steps.player: It doesn't really sound like anyone is living in fear apart from you.

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: More fool them! Count Draynor has cast a shadow over Draynor Village for generations. They even named the place after him for Saradomin's sake!

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: Even if the people here don't realise it, we will never be at peace until we know he's dead!

steps.player: If you're sure... I guess I'll go and see this Dr Harlow.

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: Thank you, brave adventurer.

options.text: Alright, I'll see about paying him a visit.

steps.player: Alright, I'll see about paying him a visit.

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: Thank you, brave adventurer.

options.text: No.

steps.player: An evil vampyre? I don't think this is the job for me. It sounds far too scary!

steps.speaker: Morgan
steps.text: I understand... Hopefully someone else will come along to finally save us from this evil.

starting-off-talking-to-morgan-again.speaker: Morgan
starting-off-talking-to-morgan-again.text: Adventurer! Has Count Draynor been dealt with yet?

starting-off-talking-to-morgan-again.speaker: Morgan
starting-off-talking-to-morgan-again.text: Please hurry! I'm sure Dr Harlow in Varrock's Blue Moon Inn can help.

options.text: What else can you tell me about Count Draynor?
Alright, I'll see about paying him a visit.
I need your help dealing with a vampyre.

steps.player: I need your help dealing with a vampyre.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: A vampyre you shhay...?

steps.player: Not just any vampyre. Count Draynor.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Draynor? Well, buy me a beer firsht...

steps.player: Are you sure you've not had enough?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Huh? No, I don't think ssho. Now, buy ush a beer.

options.text: I think you've had enough.

steps.player: I think you've had enough.

dr-harlow-talking-to-him-again.speaker: Dr Harlow
dr-harlow-talking-to-him-again.text: Have yoush got me a beer?

options.text: I'll go and get you one.

steps.player: I'll go and get you one.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Cheersh, matey...

options.text: Yes, here you go.
options.condition: If the player has a beer:

steps.player: Yes, here you go.

steps.text: You give a beer to Dr Harlow.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Cheersh, matey...

steps.player: Now, about Count Draynor...

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Yesh, Count Draynor! The evil nashty vampyre that no one's ever sheen! Every nowsh and then, some adventurer... theysh go and try to kill him, but none of 'em ever comesh back.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: You want to havesh a go? Then don't be likesh them! Be prepared! Vampyres... Theysh hard to kill. Some... maybe imposhible.

steps.player: So how do I make sure I'm prepared?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Most vampyres regenerate. Yoush need to stop them. I knowsh a few ways, but the easiest ish a stake. Here, You can havesh thish one.
Dr Harlow hands you a stake.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Takesh that to Draynor Manor. Find the vampyre inshide and show him what for! When hesh weak, use a hammer to drive the stake in! Mosht general stores have them.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Oh, and yoush should take some garlic with you as well. Vampyres don't likesh garlic.

steps.player: Garlic? Hmm... I'll see if Morgan knows where I can get some.

options.text: You said no one's ever seen Count Draynor?

steps.player: You said no one's ever seen Count Draynor?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: No, butsh every now and then someonesh tried to kill him.

steps.player: But they've never come back? Meaning someone or something killed them most likely. Presumably Count Draynor?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Yesh, I'd say so.

steps.player: So why does he never leave his manor?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Who knowsh. Most likely he's grown too weak to do ssho.

steps.player: Weak? So he shouldn't be too hard to kill then?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Even a weak vampyre ish very dangerous. Just go ashk those other adventurers thatsh never came back.

options.text: What do I need to do again?

steps.player: What do I need to do again?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Go to Draynor Manor. Find the vampyre inshide and show him what for! When hesh weak, use a hammer to drive that stake I gave you in! Mosht general stores have them.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Oh, and yoush should take some garlic with you as well. Vampyres don't likesh garlic.

steps.player: Garlic? Hmm... I'll see if Morgan knows where I can get some.

options.text: So you were once a proper vampyre hunter?

So you were once a proper vampyre hunter?

steps.player: So you were once a proper vampyre hunter?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Yesh! I travelled their homeland to the easht. Morytania! I killed lotsh of vampyres over there!

steps.player: What was the most dangerous vampyre you killed?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Dangerous? Oh, well... Ish never killed one of the really dangerous ones.

steps.player: Why not?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Can't. Theysh too strong. Nothing cansh hurt them.

steps.player: Oh... But what if Count Draynor's like that?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Yoush don't get many vampyres around here. Pretty much none, actshually. There's speshial magic that stops them coming over here. Any that are here... theysh weak... and trapped.

steps.player: So how come you've never tried to kill him yourself?

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Why bother? Hesh not killed anyone in a long time, so no one really caresh about him that much, apart from the odd adventurer thatsh looking to prove themshelves.

steps.player: I see. Fair enough.

options.text: I'd best get going.

steps.player: I'd best get going.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: Good luck, matey...

options.text: No. I think you've had enough.

steps.player: No. I think you've had enough.

steps.speaker: Dr Harlow
steps.text: No help for yoush then.
